definition: Frame supplies a fixed Sentence type, an AttitudeProfile type with one actual profile, holds at each profile, and an independently supplied objective classifier. Stable f s means ∀ p, holds p s ↔ holds actual s. The intended comparison varies attitudes while content and non-attitude facts stay fixed; those application conditions are not inferred from the field names.
note: Analyst operational arena for competing truth definitions. This is not property identity, robust representation, causal independence, knowledge or a proof that a real language has these profiles. The actual field explicitly witnesses a profile; an evil parameter in the external result explicitly witnesses its sentence. No conclusion about actual thinkers or a deity is inferred.
